scope: Main Pump only; all 218 unmatched original function windows assigned for recovery or initial static triage. Attribution is provisional, not proof of semantics.
baseline_candidate: Round41 verified and selected as maintained source; the publication receipt records its commit. Later isolated deliveries are not counted here.

lanes.build_identity: Creation account parsers/wrappers, remaining Anchor/Borsh framework code, then assigned unattributed windows.
lanes.context_finish: Legacy/V2 trading and exact shared fee/CPI/accounting helpers, then assigned unattributed windows.
lanes.claim_finish: V3 accounting and continuation helpers, remaining core instruction bodies and assigned unattributed windows.
lanes.root: Compose frozen deliveries, maintain full regression/build reproduction, coordinate source/data/relocation identity and push checkpoints.

crosscutting_requirements.work: Recover remaining readonly data and source/toolchain layout with evidence; no artificial padding.
Extend original-vs-candidate signed behavior coverage for newly discovered instruction branches and data/return boundaries.
Maintain checked error ordering, account-state and event equivalence for remaining core instruction bodies.
Verify compiler-produced meaningful ELF identity; separately verify loader allocation image, reproducibility, data and relocation closure before completion.
Keep current source, README metrics, published main branch and provenance synchronized.

safety_boundary: The previously stopped token-owner experiment remains preserved locally and is not retried in these assignments.

ownership_rule: Explicit source ownership takes precedence over initial balanced unknown-window triage; coordinate shared helpers before editing.

cross_cutting_work.task: Integrate independent deliveries, recompile fresh main code, run the bound full/focused corpus, seal reproducible evidence and publish current README metrics.
cross_cutting_work.complete_when: Four main builds agree, public source/build/diagnostic/signature verifiers pass, and the non-force push is verified.

cross_cutting_work.task: Recover and prove original main ELF data, source-path structures, relocations, section layout and build provenance.
cross_cutting_work.complete_when: Rust-source reproduction matches the complete captured main ELF without original executable injection, byte patches, synthetic padding or masked-data claims.

cross_cutting_work.task: Creation/migration ABI and validation recovery, main build/dependency provenance, and all assigned unmatched windows.
cross_cutting_work.complete_when: Original-backed Rust source and signed differential cases cover the assigned unmatched paths, with exact body/data proof tracked independently.

cross_cutting_work.task: Legacy/V2 trading, account validation, fee/recipient and Sweep helper recovery plus all assigned unmatched windows.
cross_cutting_work.complete_when: Original-backed Rust source and signed differential cases cover the assigned unmatched paths, with exact body/data proof tracked independently.

cross_cutting_work.task: V3/claim/incentive helper and validation recovery plus all assigned unmatched windows.
cross_cutting_work.complete_when: Original-backed Rust source and signed differential cases cover the assigned unmatched paths, with exact body/data proof tracked independently.

overall_acceptance: Main Pump only. Complete Rust-built captured-ELF identity, independently verified source/build provenance, and original-backed behavior coverage; normalized-window ratios are progress metrics and never whole-project completion.
